en.title: Configuring Qualification Sessions
en.excerpt: How to structure qualification sessions, ends per session, arrows per end, and multi-distance formats.
en.content:
Session Architecture

Qualification rounds rank archers before seeding them into elimination match trees. A tournament can contain multiple qualification sessions (e.g., Session 1 for Youth Divisions, Session 2 for Senior Recurve/Compound).

Session Configuration Parameters

In Tournament Dashboard > Qualification > click + Add Session:

  • Session Title: Descriptive name (e.g., Qualification Round 1 - 70m Morning).
  • Total Ends: Number of ends in the session (typically 6 ends for 36 arrows, or 12 ends for 72 arrows).
  • Arrows per End: Number of arrows shot per end (standard is 6 arrows outdoor, 3 arrows indoor).
  • Warm-up Ends: Practice ends scheduled before official scoring commences (typically 2 ends).

Standard World Archery Presets

Common tournament session formats:

  • WA 720 Round: 72 arrows total (Two 36-arrow sessions of 6 ends × 6 arrows at 70m/50m).
  • Indoor 600 Round: 60 arrows total (Two 30-arrow sessions of 10 ends × 3 arrows at 18m).
  • National Development Round: 36 arrows total (One session of 6 ends × 6 arrows at 30m).

Linking Categories to Sessions

Assign specific categories to each session to ensure that target allocations and scorekeeper interfaces display only the athletes scheduled to shoot in that time slot.
